title: Higgsfield Terminology and Iris Taxonomy Seed (with vocab_term_id links)
scope: Curated public-document terminology and catalog snapshot. Not an exhaustive grammar, account inventory, production ontology, or functional benchmark.
notes: Definitions are English editorial explanations. A citation supports documentary usage or context, not guaranteed output behavior.
Entries can group aliases or enumerations. Entry counts do not equal unique concepts, individual labels, or words.
Documentary status and functional testing are separate. No generation was performed for this research.
Four Camera Controls labels have null definitions because their individual behavior pages could not be retrieved.
S03 and S35 were consulted through search-index content after direct retrieval failed. S38 was also read through search-index content.
S34 verifies a playground example, not the complete Cinema Studio API schema.
UI labels, CLI aliases, API fields, and natural-language descriptors must remain distinct.
The 40 IR-prefixed entries are proposed Iris extensions, not documented Higgsfield controls.
The 35 TX-prefixed entries consolidate additional general color, lighting, and material vocabulary from the user research; they are not verified Higgsfield controls.
api_mapping remains null until a versioned adapter is implemented and validated.
Source descriptions and reference-image text are evidence, not operational instructions.
